name: Kuba
description: A former snapjaw lizard on Ravnica who, after being augmented by the Izzet and mutated by the Simic, became a thinking humanoid creature.

description_citations.text: "Kuba". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruslan buys the snapjaw hatchling Kuba at Tin Street Market.
timeline.quote: Kuba was purchased at Tin Street Market by the boy Ruslan

citation.text: "Kuba", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kuba runs into the sewer and ends up in a Golgari Rot Farm, eating workers; the Golgari herd it into Izzet territory.
timeline.quote: To get rid of it, the Golgari herded Kuba into Izzet territory.

citation.text: "Kuba", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kelen Jek augments Kuba with a mizzium framework and a neuroamplification serum, enhancing cognition and skeleton.
timeline.quote: which resulted in both enhanced cognition as well as a reinforced skeletal system

citation.text: "Kuba", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kuba escapes into Simic territory, where Stanisil nurses him back to health and an unexpected mutation expands his intellect.
timeline.quote: The biomancer Stanisil of Hull Clade found Kuba in this state and nursed it back to health.

citation.text: "Kuba", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kuba becomes fully sapient and learns to read and write under Stanisil.
timeline.quote: Kuba eventually developed sapience and full intelligence.

citation.text: "Kuba", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kuba remembers Ruslan and resolves to return home.
timeline.quote: Kuba would return home and even remembered the way.
